tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Void Black. The instrument field; page ground for Instrument and Mandala voices. Shadows are cast from it, never grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Elevated panels, capsule masthead, dialogs on the void.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Primary copy on void; the Folio page ground.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, breadcrumbs, quiet chrome on void/surface (6.4:1).

tokens.name: sacred-gold
tokens.usage: Structure accent: line, type, glow — never a large fill. Active nav, the gilt edge, Pichet's color. On parchment it is a mark only (2.1:1); use folio-rule for text there.

tokens.name: gold-warm
tokens.usage: Warmer gold for glows, blooms and the diamond-star fill.

tokens.name: witness-violet
tokens.usage: Depth, threshold, contemplation; Union Mirror and Bridge Query room accent. A ground, not a text color on void.

tokens.name: flow-indigo
tokens.usage: Flow and primary action fills; hex-cell borders in the engine mandala. 3.3:1 on void: marks and fills only, never small text on void. Parchment text on it holds 5.0:1.

tokens.name: coherence-emerald
tokens.usage: Signal, alive, coherence; computed evidence mark; Aletheios' color.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Unresolved evidence mark.

tokens.name: violet-glow
tokens.usage: Witness evidence mark and glow.

tokens.name: ink-bronze
tokens.usage: Folio chrome and sigil ink on parchment (7.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-iron
tokens.usage: High-contrast headings on parchment.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground for the current voice.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs. Folio does not raise surfaces; it separates with rules.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on bg and bg-raised (16.7:1 Instrument, 14.7:1 Folio).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on bg and bg-raised (11.1:1 / 6.4:1).

tokens.name: text-metadata
tokens.usage: Timestamps, counts, captions on bg and bg-raised.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (4.7:1 on surface; 3.3:1 on parchment — exempt as disabled).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: capsule, pills, dialogs, folio dividers. Folio's rule doubles as its gold text (4.9:1).

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on pills and capsule controls.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Active/selected marker: nav diamond, active hex, chapter heads (Folio).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring on every control (10.3:1 on void, 5.0:1 on parchment).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selection state — navigation, never analytical truth.

tokens.name: evidence-computed
tokens.usage: Computed evidence mark (rule, dot, ring). Pair with the word.

tokens.name: evidence-witness
tokens.usage: Witnessed evidence mark. Pair with the word.

tokens.name: evidence-unresolved
tokens.usage: Unresolved evidence mark. Pair with the word.

tokens.name: evidence-copy-computed
tokens.usage: Computed-evidence label text on bg (11.0:1 / 5.2:1). Folio value is a system addition.

tokens.name: evidence-copy-witness
tokens.usage: Witness-evidence label text on bg (9.1:1 / 6.9:1). Folio value is a system addition.

tokens.name: evidence-copy-unresolved
tokens.usage: Unresolved-evidence label text on bg (8.7:1 / 5.8:1). Folio value is a system addition.

tokens.name: on-flow
tokens.usage: Text on a flow-indigo fill (5.0:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a sacred-gold fill (7.8:1).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing hero, one per surface. Uppercase.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Parent-page title, engraved Roman caps. Uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: URANIA 137 / NOESIS wordmark in the masthead. Uppercase.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings in the Instrument voice.

styles.name: node-label
styles.usage: Graph node, hex-cell and nav labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: epithet
styles.usage: Gold epithet under a title. Uppercase, sacred-gold.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Overline, breadcrumb. 10px is below the 12px metadata floor; keep it to uppercase single words.

styles.name: sub
styles.sample: Each room opens a lens over the Selemene engine pool.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Prose in the Instrument voice, max 70ch.
styles.sample: Source, inference, and conclusion stay separate — never collapsed into one claim.

styles.name: folio-title
styles.usage: Chapter title on parchment (set in engraving face).

styles.name: folio-chapter
styles.usage: Chapter / page folio line, uppercase, folio-rule ink.

styles.name: folio-body
styles.usage: Long-form reading body, 680px column, 1em indent after the first paragraph.
styles.sample: When the currents of thought, once scattered as distant stars, begin to bend toward a single center, a new field is born.

styles.name: mandala-wordmark
styles.usage: Splash and brand-mark wordmark, wide tracking. Uppercase.

styles.name: mandala-label
styles.usage: The one quiet line under a mandala.
styles.sample: ENTER WHEN THE QUESTION IS ACTIVE
